title: ‘We will sue them’: Canada threatens Stellantis as Trump trade war reshapes Jeep production plans
summary_full: The dispute comes after Stellantis scrapped planned Jeep Compass production in Brampton and shifted future output to Illinois amid U.S. auto tariffs.
summary_public: The dispute comes after Stellantis scrapped planned Jeep Compass production in Brampton and shifted future output to Illinois amid U.S. auto tariffs.
